item.coloph: phan byed gto thabs sum cu zhes bya ba/ gshen rab chen pos 'gro ba'i don la gsungs pas/ rgyal gshen mu khri btsan po dang gshen nam mkha'i snang ba mdog can gnyis la gnyer gtad do/ rgyal gshen de gnyis kyis gnas chen bon ri'i lha ri gyer gyi dbu rtser btsun pa kun dga' tshul khrims bdag la lung brtan (bstan) nas bka' rgya med par snyan du brgyud pa'o//
